text.card: A red giant 2,961 parsecs away, 10 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 13, give 0.90 solar masses and 9.8 solar radii; GALAH spectra give 4,920 K at its surface.
